description: Exact ADR-0025 VPN/private ACA DNS deltas against pre-POC develop. Preserves original scoped-resource-group and historical fingerprints; does not exempt unrelated resources, metadata, or security properties.

metadata.description: Deploy an Entra/OpenVPN point-to-site gateway and inbound DNS resolver. Requires network isolation; disabled by default.
Microsoft-registered Azure VPN Client audience in Azure public cloud.
Point-to-site IPv4 client CIDR. Required when VPN is enabled and must not overlap any connected network.
Name of the dedicated DNS resolver subnet.
Dedicated /28 or larger DNS resolver subnet CIDR inside the VNet. Required when VPN is enabled.
Optional VPN gateway name override; empty uses the workload resource token.
Gateway SKU; incurs charges while provisioned.
Entra tenant for VPN authentication.
Internal Container Apps environment default domain.
Internal environment static ingress IPv4 address.
VNet from which clients resolve the internal app domain.
Resource tags.

Resource tags.
VPN gateway ARM resource ID.
Gateway public IPv4 address.
DNS server address to configure in the Azure VPN Client profile.
Gateway name used to generate the Azure VPN Client profile.
